description: This file contains a helper module for GPG signing operations, including class LocalSigner with methods for exporting keys, signing RPMs, creating detached signatures, verifying signatures, and related utilities.

classes.name: LocalSigner
classes.description: Class for handling local (on the build host) signing, with methods to export keys, sign RPMs, detach sign, verify signatures, and retrieve GPG version.

methods.name: __init__(self, d)
methods.description: Initializes the LocalSigner object with configuration variables.

methods.name: export_pubkey(self, output_file, keyid, armor=True)
methods.description: Exports a GPG public key to a specified output file.

methods.name: sign_rpms(self, files, keyid, passphrase, digest, sign_chunk, fsk=None, fsk_password=None)
methods.description: Signs RPM files using GPG, with support for signing in chunks.

methods.name: detach_sign(self, input_file, keyid, passphrase_file, passphrase=None, armor=True, output_suffix=None, use_sha256=False)
methods.description: Creates a detached signature of a file.

methods.name: verify(self, sig_file, valid_sigs = '')
methods.description: Verifies a signature file against signatures, optionally matching specific signatures.

methods.name: get_gpg_version(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the installed GPG version as a tuple.

ctags.name: sign_rpms
ctags.pattern: /^    def sign_rpms(self, files, keyid, passphrase, digest, sign_chunk, fsk=None, fsk_password=Non/
